description: Storytelling is one of mankind's greatest strengths, and in this challenge, this ancient art crosses paths with one of the most fascinating stories of all; the unwritten history of abandoned Mars rovers.
summary: I developed a fictionalized version of the Opportunity Mars rover's life, told through the eyes of the rover itself, in the form of a digital storybook. My story explores the rover’s life, and how it must have felt when the dust storm hit, and Opportunity lost connection,  officially becoming a “ghost rover". My story addresses the challenge in a unique new way; it shows how it must have felt being an abandoned piece of equipment, and puts the readers in the shoes of one of the most famous abandoned rovers in history. The stories behind the abandoned equipment on the moon and mars are powerful enough to move a whole generation. The only problem is, often times, these stories may not appeal to children, which is where I come in. My take on the story of Opportunity is tailored specifically for children, and by making this story more accessible to a whole new audience, it can open up so many new doors. A young child who reads this story, may go on to one day be the engineer or scientist behind the latest rover, all because they got the experience of an incredible, life changing story, that they might not have read if they didn’t find engaging enough!
details: My project is a digital storybook for kids that explores the life of the Opportunity rover, through the eyes of the rover itself. It is intended to be an accurate, engaging, and fun resource for kids to refer to so they can learn about abandoned tools and rovers that were left behind on Mars and the Moon. The intended impact of my project is to introduce a whole generation of kids to the fascinating world of space exploration, and what humans left behind in space, in a fun and engaging way that makes kids want to learn. Stories can have the power to change lives, and my story has the potential to make an astronomical impact on the lives of many. I created my digital storybook through Canva. My project is creative because it offers a fresh new perspective on this matter, by literally telling the story from the perspective of a currently dormant Mars rover.
